title: TypeSomething pill button
description: Bold pill button: acid-green fill, a hairline outline or bare. On hover it fills with the text colour, flips its label to the page colour and lifts 2px in 160ms.
notes: hover fills with the foreground colour, so inside a .dark card it turns light
name: typesomething-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: acid-green pill · outline: hairline pill in the text colour · ghost: no border

props.name: icon
props.description: icon after the label (e.g. an arrow)
